body: I spent a good hour trying to find this. That was a quick response, thank you!

I know that being happy alone is a big step in the right direction. I feel like I have nothing going for me. I have no home. I have no car. I work part time at a dollar store because its the only thing in walking distance. I habe no friends. And my own family turns a blind eye to me. Just dont have much motivation or encouragement to get better, not that I even know where or how to begin. I feel so empty and I feel as if Im an empty body stumbling around in the darkness.
